profile.headline: Software Engineer, Android @ Google | Ex-Slack/Amazon
profile.summary:
Experienced Android Engineer and leader with a history of working on large-scale projects (2.5 Billion+ devices), co-founding and tech leading teams, and coordinating cross-team Engineering strategy.

A few notable projects among many others: Many of Google's Android apps (Play Store, Google Play Services, Maps, Keep, and more), Slack, Amazon Flex, ESPN Sportscenter, Under Armor Shop, Eero

Plus notable personal apps on the Google Play store (8 total), which I’ve since sold to other companies:
* #3 on the entire app store at peak with "Scientific 7 Minute Workout" (generating ~$10k/day revenue at peak)
* #16 on the entire app store at peak with "SimplyScan: PDF Document Scanner"
* #37 on the entire app store at peak with "Frequency: App Usage Tracking"

positions.title: Software Engineer, Tech Lead, Android
positions.description:
Tech Lead for the Google Play Store on Android XR, Android’s newest platform

https://blog.google/products/android/android-xr/

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer, Tech Lead, Android
positions.description:
I was the Tech Lead and co-founder of Slack's UI Infrastructure team. I was also a Software Engineer in designing and building out each of our areas of the the app's UI infrastructure.

I shaped the team’s ownership by identifying key areas of improvement of the app’s UI layer, including:
* Identifying and leading a full-app architecture migration and modernization, involving all Android teams and engineers at Slack. This involved several quarters of identifying key problem areas, building out infrastructure, and forming the migration strategy, as well as several quarters of coordinating cross-team resourcing and app-wide migrations.
* App navigation 
* UI performance 
* Strategy for migrating to our Compose-based design system
* Forming partnerships with other teams such as our design library team
* Rich text rendering
* Started up Slack's new Android engineering design process

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Tech Lead, Android
positions.description:
I was on the Android@Google team as one of the team founders, bringing a cohesive set of features across Google's Android apps. We launched all of Android 12's new home screen widgets for Google apps, a portion of which I built, among other app projects.

https://blog.google/products/android/widgets-just-got-better-android-12/

I additionally created and owned the end-to-end metrics library, pipeline, and dashboarding for all Google widgets, and dove into platform-level and server-side tech stacks. Top-level visibility from the success of this long-term end-to-end metrics project spawned similar project initiatives in other Google Android products. 

Past:
I worked on Google Play Services for Android, creating on-device solutions that provided Google services to 2+ billion devices. 

While taking into account massive scaling and stability, my work focused on app-side modularity to allow tens of Google teams to contribute to one app, working closely on the framework to allow dynamic code/resource loading, and serverside work for app distribution.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II, Android
positions.description:
I implemented new features and solved complex problems for the Amazon Flex app on Android, a platform allowing crowd-sourced package delivery. 

Other than delivering several large projects such as the integration of scheduling offers into the app (allowing drivers to have flexible hours) as well as a large app refactor, I had also been a major proponent of bringing modern frameworks into the app to make development lives easier and improve app stability, such as using Android's Architecture Components or using Kotlin as the app's first-class language. I was also voluntarily one of the maintainers of the Kotlin language, both in apps and services, at Amazon.

I also spent time on the Flex mobile tools team making app SDKs and systems that captured metrics and analytics for Amazon Flex for both Android and iOS, including integrating crash reporting into the iOS app, making a front-end service that allows feature owners to query and visualize app metrics on dashboards, and made improvements to our metrics pipeline.

positions.title: Owner, Software Engineer
positions.description:
Appuccino is my LLC from which I've produced apps to the Google Play store and Apple App Store, as well as completed several app consulting projects. I personally published 8 apps of my own to the Google Play store and 1 app to the iOS App Store - 3 of which were notable successes, and all of which have been sold to other businesses:

* #3 on the entire Google Play store at peak with "Scientific 7 Minute Workout"​ (generated ~$10k revenue in one day at peak)
* #16 on the entire Google Play store at peak with "SimplyScan: PDF Document Scanner"​
* #37 on the entire Google Play store at peak with "Frequency: App Usage Tracking"
* Total of 1.2M+ app downloads

On top of this, as a consultant, I made 2 apps from ground zero: Shadowbox and BLUR

positions.title: Android Engineer
positions.description:
Completed large features on several big-name Android apps, all using modern Android libraries and architectural patterns. 

ESPN Sportscenter
Under Armour Shop
Eero
WiseWear

positions.title: Lead, Co-Founder, Android Developer
positions.description: Led and co-founded the startup TheCampusFeed, an anonymous social platform for college students. As a team of 3, with me building the Android app and the others building the iOS app and server infrastructure, we became very closely tied with Startup Aggieland's startup incubator to perfect its business structure as well as meet investors.

positions.title: Android Development Intern
positions.description: I worked on the Softcard project which was a continuation of the same project as the previous internship, though this time with the root consulting company working on the app. My work involved implementing new features of the Android app.

positions.title: Android Development Intern
positions.description: Worked on the mobile payments solution Softcard (later bought by Google) as the Android development intern, creating proof of concepts for future features of the app.

honors.title: Student Robotics Maze Competition Winner
honors.description: Took first place in the Lego Robotics competition at Texas A&M using Lego MINDSTORMS and the LabView graphical programming environment.
honors.issuer: Issued by Dr. Narasimha Reddy · May 2012
